boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UC San Diego study and lounge destinations with documented student-facing uses.

cards.title: Geisel Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus library study space
cards.notes: Choose a floor that fits your session, then use the library’s study-space details and current-hours link before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A large central-campus library with 3,000 listed study seats.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Geisel Library with 3,000 study seats and academic-quarter hours running continuously from Sunday morning through Friday evening.
cards.access_notes: A valid campus ID is required after midnight; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: WongAvery Library
cards.subtitle: UC San Diego library study space
cards.notes: Use WongAvery for a focused library session and check the current-hours page before making it your evening work stop.
cards.short_summary: A second UC San Diego library with 900 listed study seats.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists WongAvery Library as a study location with 900 seats and links to its current hours and study-space details.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day and academic calendar; check the current library-hours link before visiting.

cards.title: Price Center
cards.subtitle: University Center study rooms and lounges
cards.notes: Reserve an individual or group room when needed; otherwise use the documented indoor or outdoor lounge and study seating.
cards.short_summary: A University Center with reservable rooms plus open lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego states that Price Center has reservable individual and group study rooms plus many indoor and outdoor study and lounge spaces that need no reservation.
cards.access_notes: Room availability and University Centers hours can change during finals, holidays, breaks, and summer.

cards.title: Original Student Center
cards.subtitle: University Center non-reservable study options
cards.notes: Settle into one of the non-reservable study options, then check University Centers hours if your work session may run late.
cards.short_summary: A documented University Center destination with non-reservable study space.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego identifies the Student Center as part of its University Centers study inventory and says it has several non-reservable study-space options.
cards.access_notes: University Centers hours vary; check current hours before visiting, especially during breaks and finals.

cards.title: RIMAC Annex 2nd Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: RIMAC Annex study lounge
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and choose couch-style seating or a table; confirm Recreation availability when academic-calendar hours change.
cards.short_summary: A 40-plus-seat lounge with additional outdoor seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists the RIMAC Annex second-floor lounge with 40-plus indoor spots, additional outdoor seating, couches, tables, and chairs.
cards.access_notes: Listed academic-quarter hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–11 p.m. weekends; hours may change.

cards.title: Triton Transfer Hub
cards.subtitle: Pepper Canyon Hall, Room 261
cards.notes: For a small group, check booking details near finals; during finals, use the conference or quiet room as open study when offered.
cards.short_summary: A transfer-focused hub with conference and quiet study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists the Triton Transfer Hub in Pepper Canyon Hall Room 261 and notes conference and quiet study rooms for group study or open study during finals.
cards.access_notes: Listed weekday hours are 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; room use changes near finals, so check the hub’s current information.

cards.title: Price Center Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Level 1, Price Center East
cards.notes: Use the tables, seating, outlets, microwave, or hot-water dispensers between commitments; bring what you need for a short reset.
cards.short_summary: A commuter lounge with practical study and break amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego describes the Price Center Commuter Lounge as a Level 1 Price Center East space with lockers, microwaves, sofas, tables, chairs, and power outlets.
cards.access_notes: This lounge is designed for commuter students; verify any current eligibility or access information with Commuter Services.

cards.title: El Portal
cards.subtitle: Muir Commuter Lounge, north of Middle of Muir
cards.notes: Use the quiet room or study tables for a focused block, and plan around the lounge’s commuter-oriented amenities and access rules.
cards.short_summary: A Muir commuter lounge with desks, a quiet room, and hydration station.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego identifies Muir Commuter Lounge “El Portal” north of Middle of Muir and lists couches, study tables, desks, a quiet room, and a hydration station.
cards.access_notes: Commuter lockers are available to rent quarterly; confirm current access details with Commuter Services.

cards.title: Sixth College Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: Catalyst Building, North Torrey Pines Living and Learning Neighborhood
cards.notes: Use the computers, nearby printer access, kitchen facilities, and seating for a practical study break in the Sixth neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A commuter center with computers, kitchen facilities, and lounge furniture.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego places the Sixth College Commuter Center in the Catalyst Building basement and lists wireless internet, computers, printer access, kitchen facilities, and comfortable furniture.
cards.access_notes: The page lists it as open seven days a week, 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; confirm hours during holidays and breaks.

cards.title: Angela’s Space
cards.subtitle: Marshall College study space
cards.notes: Use the shared seating for an individual or small-group session, and check Marshall College information if your visit falls during a break.
cards.short_summary: A Marshall College study space explicitly open to all students.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Angela’s Space as a 50-seat Marshall College study space that is open to all students.
cards.access_notes: Listed academic-quarter hours are 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; availability may change during finals, holidays, breaks, and summer.
